items.title: Player interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2012
items.q: Wynton Marsalis had put out a great educational program for kids of traditional jazz.

ctx.x: And they’ve figured out a way, whether we could debate about it or not, they figured out a way to codify what he did, and teach it. But can you codify what a second line is and what those musicians do?

Yeah I think that you can do that in the same way that you could the other styles that they’re doing in the university. I don’t think it’s the same as, like I said, getting the experience on the bandstand. It’s never the same. I mean you can’t get that out of a book, no matter what you’re studying. But when I was in the Y in New York we had a program, I can’t remember the name of it but Wynton Marsalis had put out a great educational program for kids of traditional jazz. And he explained everything. We went…
I know. Doesn’t that make you crazy?
